description: This file defines the interface and data structures for integrating native Android application code with the Android system, including callback mechanisms, event handling, and main application entry point.

classes.name: android_app
classes.description: Structure representing the native application state and callback handlers.

classes.name: android_poll_source
classes.description: Structure representing a source of events for the application's looper.

methods.name: android_app_read_cmd
methods.description: Reads the next command message from the application's command queue.

methods.name: android_app_pre_exec_cmd
methods.description: Performs initial processing of a command received from the main thread.

methods.name: android_app_post_exec_cmd
methods.description: Performs final processing after handling a command.

methods.name: app_dummy
methods.description: Dummy function to prevent stripping of glue code.

methods.name: android_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the application, to be implemented by the app developer.
